SECRET.
JS/KV/1252

14th September, 1942.

Dear Aikin-Sneath,

I refer to my JS/KV/3956 of the 1st August. Can you please let me know what you were able to arrange about the RETZLAW correspondence?

Yours sincerely,

[hand signed] John E. Smith

F. B. Aikin-Sneath, Esq.,
M.I.5.,
London.
